_note: Places on the road are given as s (metres along the centre line from the start line) and off (metres to the right of it).

checkpoints._note: shares of the lap; they must be passed in this order and the last one (the start line) completes the lap. rules.json says how many there are.

car._note: any tuning member of TLVehicle. The nitro tank does not refill by itself here: only the pad fills it.

cones._jitter: each cone lands up to this far (m) from its place; the spawner draws it from ctx.rng, so --seed moves the cones
